findings.title: CVE Record: CVE-2026-119077
findings.summary_md: The Wordfence CVE record describes a CWE-502 PHP object injection in the elextensions ELEX WordPress HelpDesk & Customer Ticketing System plugin through version 3.3.9, reached through the attacker-controlled ticket_label field inside the url-encoded form parameter. It attributes the flaw to missing server-side authentication and no class allowlist on deserialization, with a nonce publicly emitted on any page carrying the [wsdesk_support] shortcode as the only guard. The record assigns CVSS 3.1 base score 9.8, credits finder Osman Hussein, and logs vendor notification on 2026-10-29 and disclosure on 2026-11-12.

findings.title: CVE Record: CVE-2026-125855
findings.summary_md: The Patchstack CVE record covers deserialization of untrusted data (CWE-502) in the same ELEX WordPress HelpDesk & Customer Ticketing System plugin, affecting versions up to 3.3.9 and marking 3.4.0 as unaffected. It assigns the same CVSS 3.1 base score 9.8 and the same AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H vector, credits hinhlx of the Patchstack Bug Bounty Program, and cites a Patchstack vulnerability database entry. The record gives no separate exploit path or exploitation claim.

findings.title: WSDesk WordPress Helpdesk Plugin (Free) Changelog
findings.summary_md: The vendor changelog lists V 3.4.0 as released 12-Nov-2026 with a security fix for a vulnerability issue; the preceding 3.3.8 entry notes a fix for unauthorized file deletion in the factory reset functionality. The page metadata carries an article modified timestamp of 2026-11-12T06:24:49Z. The changelog does not name CVE-2026-119077 or describe the deserialization sink.

findings.title: im0xfay/CVE-2026-119077 PoC exploit repository
findings.summary_md: This public repository publishes a Python proof of concept describing a GET to harvest wsdesk_nonce followed by an anonymous POST to admin-ajax.php with action eh_crm_new_ticket_post, with the deserialization sink at includes/class-crm-public-functions.php:875 and a bundled Guzzle FileCookieJar gadget writing a file under wp-content/uploads/. It states that 3.3.9 requires an allowlisted custom-field slug, that the 3.4.0 fix adds eh_crm_has_object_or_serialized_object() and eh_crm_safe_unserialize() in front of 26 sinks, and that the payload bypassed ModSecurity CRS 4.30.0 in a lab. The GitHub creation timestamp is 2026-11-13T08:05:55Z, before the Wordfence CVE record was published.
